newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Gross yield in Czech 4-wk T-bill auction 11.79 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gross yield in Czech 4-wk T-bill auction 11.79 pct.

text.p: The Gross yield in a Czech National Bank (CNB) Dutch-style auction of a four billion crown tranche of four week treasury bills was 11.79 percent, the CNB said on Tuesday.
The CNB said the issue was oversubscribed with bids totalling 7.879 billion. Net yield reached 8.843 percent, CNB said.
The four-week Prague interbank offered rate (PRIBOR) stood at 12.33 percent on Tuesday, up one basis point from Monday.
